notes.title: Swamp Keeper – Dev Update!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is Metdol Games![/p][p]Today, we’d like to share some newly completed content that will be added to the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Area 2 – Village[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601261/582a5b2d20db98d03b132f5ebfa3613ecb69646a.gif"][/img][/p][p]The second area is the [b]Village[/b].[/p][p]Experience new battles in a village made up of a Hamlet, a Merchant Street, and a Government Office.[/p][p]In this area, [b]enemies armed with firearms[/b] will appear.[/p][p]Let your guard down, and your tail might be gone before you know it![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601261/486cf27e3db5a9fc868e2cea9e315d9f9c2755ce.gif"][/img][/p][p]The boss, a [b]Fox[/b], is waiting for you.[/p][p]Be careful not to fall under its spell![/p][p][/p][h3]
[b]New Parts, Skills, and Items[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601261/b1a2dc1c2e098bc6b78d878ed7dca46b6ba4e220.png"][/img][/p][p]New [b]arrow parts, skills, and items[/b] have been added.[/p][p]Most are available right away, but some require meeting certain conditions to unlock.[/p][p][/p][h3]
[b]Other Updates[/b][/h3][p][b]New Skill Effects[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601261/a77936eb2994d357c6aa6508d5b5f70664d3d21b.gif"][/img][/p][p]A black-and-white effect has been added when using skills.[/p][p]It makes enemies stand out more, making them easier to hit![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Workbench in the Passage[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601261/decb48b25e1e6de5ce4e70a4bef048531c430afe.gif"][/img][/p][p]A workbench[b] [/b]has been added to the passageways.[/p][p]You can now change parts and skills right after obtaining an item.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Tail Regrowing After Boss Defeat[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601261/cc994b780ddb5c9d14d0cd72e1d9440d5cbe4b20.gif"][/img][/p][p]After defeating a boss, you can regrow your tail.[/p][p]If your tail wasn’t cut off, you’ll instead get an extra item as a bonus![/p][p][/p][p]
[b]What’s Next[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]third area[/b] will be the final one, and it’s currently in development.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re also preparing [b]extra difficulty levels[/b] and an [b]infinite mode[/b] for post-game play.[/p][/*][*][p]Development progress is about 80%, and we’re aiming for a [b]September release[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Once the release date is confirmed, we’ll let everyone know![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’d love to have your interest and support![/p][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Swamp Keeper Demo v0.0.2 Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is Maetdol Games.[/p][p]The [b]Swamp Keeper Demo[/b] has been updated![/p][p]Here are the patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]The overall difficulty has been reduced.
→ If it still feels too hard, please let us know![/p][p]→ The difficulty is still being tested and may differ from the final release.[/p][/*][*][p]The archer’s attack range has been decreased.[/p][/*][*][p]The shieldman's movement speed has been slightly reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]The bear will now destroy statues upon crash.
→ Once destroyed, statues will no longer block arrows — or bear whip attacks![/p][/*][*][p]In the tutorial, [b]arrow retrieval[/b] and [b]piercing[/b] are now introduced at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where gamepad key bindings could not be changed.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you![/p]

tags.balance_change: The overall difficulty has been reduced.
The archer’s attack range has been decreased.
The shieldman's movement speed has been slightly reduced.

tags.feature: The bear will now destroy statues upon crash.
In the tutorial, [b]arrow retrieval[/b] and [b]piercing[/b] are now introduced at the same time.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where gamepad key bindings could not be changed.
